api.title: Give the quiz a title of up to 200 characters.
api.dates: The closing date has to come after the opening date.
api.publish_empty: Add at least one question before publishing.
api.too_many_questions: A quiz can have up to {max} questions.
api.question_type: Question {number} has a type this forum does not know.
api.question_body: Question {number} needs its question, up to 5,000 characters.
api.option_length: An answer in question {number} is longer than 300 characters.
api.no_correct: Mark at least one correct answer in question {number}.
api.image_url: The image for question {number} has to be a web address starting with http:// or https://, or a path on this forum.
api.reward_locked: This quiz carries points or a badge, so only staff who can attach rewards may change its answers, points and passing score. You can still edit its wording.
api.no_attempts_left: You have used all your attempts at this quiz.
api.no_questions: This quiz has no questions yet.
api.slow_down: Too many requests in a short time. Wait a few minutes and try again.

composer.title: Add a quiz to your post

quiz.missing: This quiz doesn't exist, or you can't see it.
quiz.stats: {taken, plural, one {# attempt} other {# attempts}} · {passed} passed
quiz.link_copied: Link copied. Paste it on a line of its own in a post and the quiz appears there.
quiz.delete_confirm: Delete "{title}" with all its results? This can't be undone.

player.unanswered: {count, plural, one {# question has no answer yet.} other {# questions have no answer yet.}} Submit anyway, or go back to them.
player.error: This quiz can't be played right now.

result.expired: Time ran out. Answers saved before then were graded.
result.practice: A practice run: it doesn't count on leaderboards or earn rewards. The results show what members will see.
result.attempts_left: {count, plural, =0 {No attempts left.} one {# attempt left.} other {# attempts left.}}
result.key_hidden: The correct answers are shown once you pass or run out of attempts.

leaderboard.title: Leaderboard
leaderboard.overall_help: Ranked by quizzes passed, then by the scores behind them. Members can keep themselves off leaderboards in their settings.
leaderboard.you_overall: You: #{rank}, {count, plural, one {# quiz passed} other {# quizzes passed}}

results.none: Nobody has finished this quiz yet.
results.reset_confirm: Reset {name}'s attempts at this quiz? Their results go; points and badges already earned stay.

editor.title: Title
editor.formatting_help: You can format it the same way as a post.
editor.question: Question
editor.single_help: Select the correct answer. Add up to 10 answers.
editor.multiple_help: Select every correct answer. Add up to 10 answers.
editor.accepted_help: Every answer that counts as correct. Capital letters, accents, spacing and punctuation are ignored.
editor.explanation_placeholder: Why that's the answer (optional, shown when the answers are revealed)
editor.time_limit_help: Leave both empty for no limit. The timer runs on the server, so reloading the page doesn't reset it.
editor.max_attempts_help: How many tries each member gets. Leave empty for no limit.
editor.question_pick_help: Ask this many questions, picked at random from the whole list. Leave empty to ask them all.
editor.partial_credit_help: Off: the member gets the points only by choosing every correct answer and no wrong ones. On: each correct choice earns part of the points and each wrong choice takes a part back, so choosing everything doesn't pay off.

reveals.answers: The answers, after passing or running out of attempts

reveal_help.score: Members see their score and nothing else.
reveal_help.mistakes: Members see which questions they got right, but not the correct answers.
reveal_help.answers: The correct answers and explanations are shown once a member passes or runs out of attempts, so they can't be copied into the next try.
reveal_help.answers_always: The correct answers and explanations are shown after every attempt. Best for practice quizzes.

editor.rewards_help: Given once, the first time a member passes. Not given for the author's own attempts.

permissions.manage: Edit and delete any quiz, see every result
permissions.reward: Attach points and badges to quizzes

settings.editors_count_help: Off: whoever writes or manages a quiz can see its answers, so their attempts only count as practice. On: once a quiz is published and open, their attempts count like anyone's: leaderboards, attempt limits and rewards. Useful when the questions came from someone else (or an AI) and the writer doesn't know the answers. Drafts and quizzes not open yet stay practice.

passed.title: {count, plural, one {Pass a quiz} other {Pass # quizzes}}
passed.description: Test what you know in one of the forum's quizzes.
